# indie-market-analyst

> Open-source Indian-market analysis toolkit with deterministic intraday scanning, dashboards, backtesting, market data APIs, and optional AI-assisted chat.

indie-market-analyst is a local-first full-stack app for NSE/BSE workflows. The core product includes an intraday scanner, strategy workbench, market dashboards, and a deterministic backtest engine. The AI chat is one feature: it uses OpenRouter-backed agents, source-aware tools, strict Pydantic handoffs, and guardrails for numeric claims.

## Key facts

- Repository: https://github.com/dharunashokkumar/indie-market-analyst
- License: MIT
- Language: Python 3.12+ backend, React + TypeScript frontend
- Backend: FastAPI
- Frontend: Vite + React
- Intraday engine: deterministic Python under `intraday_engine/`
- Backtest engine: pandas/numpy with Indian cost model
- Data: NSE public endpoints, yfinance, MCX India via mcxlib, Google Finance scraping where used
- Optional AI provider: OpenRouter through the OpenAI Agents SDK

## Main features

- Seven-mode intraday scanner for pre-market, pre-open, live scan, last-hour scan, post-market review, single-symbol analysis, active-pick updates, and weekend planning.
- Configurable universes: Nifty 50, Nifty 200, Nifty 500, F&O, full NSE cash, and custom CSV.
- Setup detectors: ORB, VWAP reclaim, breakout, flag, momentum, and short-cover proxy.
- Dashboards for market overview, equity views, heatmaps, and persisted backtest runs.
- Strategy workbench across supported equities, commodities, indices, ETF/mutual-fund proxies, and crypto pairs.
- Optional AI-assisted chat with YAML teams, tool registry, skills, memory, and guardrails.
